text:
Priya: quick heads up — we need to lock the launch gates for the Q3 tenant-prefetch pilot. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am. Short blockers: runtime per-tenant KV cache TTL + prewarm, infra VPC peering/NAT + allowlist, security KMS/HSM + audit logs, product acceptance: p95 latency <=200ms and quality regression <2% on eval. Who can own which?

Marco: I can own eng integration. Need runtime API to accept per-tenant TTL + rollout flag. Also need a clear fallback model plan and a minimal integration test.

Anya: I'll take runtime changes. Quick clarifying q's: is the p95 target global or per-route? To hit 200ms p95 we'll need warm pools or aggressive prewarm; otherwise we'll rely on a smaller fallback model for bursts. Also need guidance on max seq length for prewarm. :thinking_face:

Lena: Security: for pilot KMS-only is easiest and fastest. HSM adds ~3-4 weeks and extra compliance review. I'll need a key-rotation plan, audit log retention, and a list of who gets access. If the customer insists on HSM, change to enterprise onramp.

Raj: Infra notes: VPC peering + route/allowlist work is ~2w including staging validation. Dedicated warm pool + prewarm orchestration needs 2 infra engineers ~1.5w. We also need a maintenance window for peering changes; prefer staging cut to avoid production risk.

Sam: For release gating I propose: canary 5% for 24h, automated monitors for latency/cost/quality, rollback if p95 degrades >10% vs baseline or quality regression >2.5% or cost per request >30% above baseline. Need dashboards and alerting preflight.

Priya: Proposed acceptance criteria to align on before launch: 1) Canary 5% for 24h with no major alerts, 2) p95 <=200ms on canary routes, 3) eval suite fail rate <2% on the pilot prompt set, 4) infra staging validation green, 5) security signoff on KMS + audit logs. If runtime can't hit p95 without large cost, allow fallback to smaller model with explicit SLA and cost/latency noted in docs. Everyone ok?

Anya: Agree. I'll add feature flags for fallback and telemetry. Quick config example for toggles I will land in the PR: 
```
{"prefetch": {"enabled": true, "warm_pool_size": 20, "fallback_model": "small-v1", "p95_target_ms": 200}}
```
I'll open the runtime PR by EOD and include perf baselines.

Raj: I'll open infra tickets and schedule the staging window for Wed. Blocking question: Priya — can you confirm the customer list and any fixed IPs for allowlist?

Priya: Sending the customer list and IPs in a follow-up DM now. Thanks — will surface any customer HSM asks before tomorrow's meeting. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am to triage and assign owners. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder set — 'tenant-prefetch launch gates' meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 AM (Slack event created).
